description: wms.inspire.geoportail.lu: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geoportal of the Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.inspire.geoportail.lu. Coverage: the area served by wms.inspire.geoportail.lu. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Annex III Theme Area Management/Restriction/Regulation Zones and Repor; HVD - Annex 2 Earth Observation and Environment - Water - Urban Waste . Formats seen: WMS, ATOM, GML, OGCFEAT, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-lu.
